title: Remove host metrics from core
goal: Vision: V-9. CEO direction 2026-11-18: core under 25,000 lines; after the MCP wire client, the host helpers. process_probe and vault_exec stay (core's install channel, process cleanup and forwarding use them). host_metrics has no runtime caller in core; its one core use is the local workflow's free-disk check, which core's existing disk_space contract already answers. Once Susi Commercial Apps owns host_metrics (T-CLAUDEMETRICS-1), switch that check to disk_space, delete core's copy and lower COMPLETE_SOCKET_CEILING. The winapi facade keeps its host readings: Susi Commercial Apps forbids unsafe code and calls them there.

reuse.searched: Core's susi-config disk_space (the free-disk contract the workflow now uses), host_metrics and the winapi facade's host module; Susi Commercial Apps' config runtime. Delete-only: no new code and no dependency.
